model_name: Bondora AI Credit Risk Assessment Model
dataset_source: Bondora Peer-to-Peer Lending Public Dataset (179,235 raw loans)
modeling_population: 110,342 loans (filtered via 12-month seasoning window to mitigate right-censoring)
target_definition: DefaultDate is observed (Target = 1) vs Status == 'Repaid' with no default (Target = 0)
leakage_control: 112 raw columns audited; strictly eliminated 52 post-origination columns (e.g. PrincipalBalance, RecoveryStage, LastPaymentOn) and Bondora platform scores (Rating, ExpectedLoss) to prevent target leakage.

performance_metrics.time_validation_drop_note: A 0.066 ROC-AUC drop on out-of-time future applicants reflects macroeconomic drift and changes in underwriting standards, honestly documented to avoid over-optimistic production claims.

xai_framework.lime_explainer: LimeTabularExplainer fitted on un-encoded original applicant feature domain
xai_framework.neuro_symbolic_layer: Hybrid integration combining gradient boosting risk probabilities with First-Order Logic constraints (Symbolic Scorecard & Expert Policy Rulebook)

fairness_audit.ethical_considerations: Excluding Gender directly does not eliminate proxy leakage via Loan Amount, Income, and Employment Duration. Spanish loans exhibit higher structural defaults in historical P2P data requiring country-specific calibrators.
